title.en: An Act Converting the Mapawa Barangay High School in Barangay Mapawa, Municipality of Maragusan, Province of Davao, Into the Mapawa National High School, Providing Funds Therefor, and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Converting the Mapawa Barangay High School in Barangay Mapawa, Municipality of Maragusan, Province of Davao, Into the Mapawa National High School, Providing Funds Therefor, and for Other Purposes
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Mapawa Barangay thành Trường Trung học Mapawa Quốc gia tại Barangay Mapawa, Đô thị Maragusan, Tỉnh Davao, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này, và cho các mục đích khác
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Mapawa Barangay เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Mapawa แห่งชาติ ในบารังไกย์ Mapawa เทศบาล Maragusan จังหวัด Davao และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้ และเพื่อวัตถุประสงค์อื่น
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Sekolah Menengah Mapawa Barangay menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mapawa Nasional di Barangay Mapawa, Kotamadya Maragusan, Provinsi Davao, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu, dan untuk tujuan lain
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Mapawa Barangay kepada Sekolah Menengah Mapawa Kebangsaan di Barangay Mapawa, Perbandaran Maragusan, Wilayah Davao, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu, dan untuk tujuan lain

text.en: The Mapawa Barangay High School in Barangay Mapawa, Municipality of Maragusan, Province of Davao, is hereby nationalized, to be known as the Mapawa National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
All personnel, records, equipment, buildings, facilities, and other properties of the Mapawa Barangay High School are hereby transferred to the Mapawa National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
